summary: Ultrapar Holdings Inc. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a market announcement that it will host its annual investor and analyst event, Ultra Day 2026, on October 02, 2026 at 9:00 a.m. BRT (8:00 a.m. EDT) to discuss company and portfolio strategy, accessible via ultraday2026.com.br with simultaneous English translation. Signed by CFO and Investor Relations Officer Alexandre Mendes Palhares. No transaction, stake, price, premium, advisor, board recommendation, or structural mechanic is disclosed; this is a routine event notice, not a special situation. Watch for strategy or guidance updates rather than deal terms.
